panels.title: Tasks
panels.description: Factory tasks and manual QA checks in the selected versions.

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(done) AS "Done", SUM(tasks) AS "Total" FROM summary WHERE product = '$product' AND scope != 'all' AND version IN (${version:sqlstring})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(done) AS "Done", SUM(tasks) AS "Total" FROM summary WHERE product = '$product' AND scope != 'all' AND version IN (${version:sqlstring})

panels.title: Agent hours
panels.description: The factory's developers, QA reviewer and fix rounds, measured by /factory:build. Forecast = remaining corrected with this product's history.

targets.queryText:
SELECT SUM(agent_est_h) AS "Estimate", SUM(agent_spent_h) AS "Spent",
  SUM(agent_remaining_h) AS "Remaining", SUM(agent_forecast_h) AS "Forecast" FROM summary WHERE product = '$product' AND scope != 'all' AND version IN (${version:sqlstring})
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT SUM(agent_est_h) AS "Estimate", SUM(agent_spent_h) AS "Spent",
  SUM(agent_remaining_h) AS "Remaining", SUM(agent_forecast_h) AS "Forecast" FROM summary WHERE product = '$product' AND scope != 'all' AND version IN (${version:sqlstring})

panels.title: Your hours (manual QA)
panels.description: Your manual QA checks (MAN-NN in the test plans), timed with /factory:qa manual.

targets.queryText:
SELECT SUM(your_est_h) AS "Estimate", SUM(your_spent_h) AS "Spent",
  SUM(your_remaining_h) AS "Remaining", SUM(your_forecast_h) AS "Forecast" FROM summary WHERE product = '$product' AND scope != 'all' AND version IN (${version:sqlstring})
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT SUM(your_est_h) AS "Estimate", SUM(your_spent_h) AS "Spent",
  SUM(your_remaining_h) AS "Remaining", SUM(your_forecast_h) AS "Forecast" FROM summary WHERE product = '$product' AND scope != 'all' AND version IN (${version:sqlstring})

panels.title: Tasks
panels.description: Factory tasks (agent hours) and your manual QA checks (your hours). Filter with Version, Status and Type at the top, or with the funnel on a column header. Deviation = actual vs estimate, for finished items.

targets.queryText:
SELECT ref AS "Task", title AS "Title", type AS "Type", version AS "Version", COALESCE(story, '') AS "Story",
  status AS "Status", cur_h AS "Estimate", actual_h AS "Spent", remaining_h AS "Remaining", forecast_h AS "Forecast",
  deviation_pct AS "Deviation",
  CASE WHEN rev_h IS NOT NULL AND est_h IS NOT NULL AND rev_h != est_h THEN 'was ' || est_h || ' h' ELSE '' END AS "Re-estimated"
FROM tasks
WHERE product = '$product' AND version IN (${version:sqlstring}) AND status IN (${status:sqlstring}) AND type IN (${type:sqlstring})
ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'Failed' THEN 0 WHEN 'Blocked' THEN 1 WHEN 'In progress' THEN 2 WHEN 'In review' THEN 3 WHEN 'Ready' THEN 4 WHEN 'To do' THEN 5 WHEN 'Waiting' THEN 6 WHEN 'Gated' THEN 7 WHEN 'Done' THEN 8 WHEN 'Passed' THEN 9 ELSE 99 END, version DESC, ref
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ref AS "Task", title AS "Title", type AS "Type", version AS "Version", COALESCE(story, '') AS "Story",
  status AS "Status", cur_h AS "Estimate", actual_h AS "Spent", remaining_h AS "Remaining", forecast_h AS "Forecast",
  deviation_pct AS "Deviation",
  CASE WHEN rev_h IS NOT NULL AND est_h IS NOT NULL AND rev_h != est_h THEN 'was ' || est_h || ' h' ELSE '' END AS "Re-estimated"
FROM tasks
WHERE product = '$product' AND version IN (${version:sqlstring}) AND status IN (${status:sqlstring}) AND type IN (${type:sqlstring})
ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'Failed' THEN 0 WHEN 'Blocked' THEN 1 WHEN 'In progress' THEN 2 WHEN 'In review' THEN 3 WHEN 'Ready' THEN 4 WHEN 'To do' THEN 5 WHEN 'Waiting' THEN 6 WHEN 'Gated' THEN 7 WHEN 'Done' THEN 8 WHEN 'Passed' THEN 9 ELSE 99 END, version DESC, ref

panels.title: Burn-down: hours remaining vs spent
panels.description: Per day, for the selected versions. Remaining = estimates of open items minus time already spent on them.

targets.queryText:
SELECT time, SUM(agent_remaining_h) AS "Agent hours remaining", SUM(your_remaining_h) AS "Your hours remaining",
  SUM(agent_spent_h) AS "Agent hours spent", SUM(your_spent_h) AS "Your hours spent"
FROM burndown WHERE product = '$product' AND scope != 'all' AND version IN (${version:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT time, SUM(agent_remaining_h) AS "Agent hours remaining", SUM(your_remaining_h) AS "Your hours remaining",
  SUM(agent_spent_h) AS "Agent hours spent", SUM(your_spent_h) AS "Your hours spent"
FROM burndown WHERE product = '$product' AND scope != 'all' AND version IN (${version:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

description: Hours estimated by /factory:plan and /factory:qa vs measured. Agent hours and your manual-QA hours are kept apart. Data: `gate time export` (runs with /factory:status and /factory:build).
